question: Which original TLA powers promised to Stewardship continued to be exercised through ERIS wallets after the three-month handover window?
cutoff_basis: Three calendar months after native proposal4817 voting ended on27August2024. The pledge does not print a start-date formula. This conservative common cutoff also exceeds the separately promised one-month administrator deadline.
scope: Strict original ten contracts from the launch registry and2September2024 transfer batch. Related later TLA and Treasury changes are separately listed; private ERIS products are not automatically part of this pledge.
